THE BANNERHOLD · KORVENIA
The holding on the scarp — site and outer territory (400 × 340 m modelled terrain)
Reversible production default — not a canonical or launch choice
Right-handed, Y-up, metres · +X east · +Z south · origin = settlement datum · drawn from the blueprint data · names are working placeholders
TERRAIN LOGIC
South flank of a basalt scarp. The land falls 8.5% to the south and 3% to the east into a 13 m ravine; a rock spur
carries the Banner Court at +9 m and the Record shelf at +6.5 m beneath crag ribs that climb to a wooded crest (≈ +28 m,
125 m north), low enough that the hall and keep break the skyline from the valley. The Muster Terrace is cut and filled
level at 0 m below the court's 9 m retaining wall; the lower town steps from −1 m to −5 m toward the ravine; the valley
brook runs ≈ 14 m below the datum.
GREATER NATION (bearing from the datum, distance)

aethelgard: 80°, 14.0 km, silhouette 40 m · Valley-mouth border keep — frontier toward solforiz: 140°, 18.0 km,

ATMOSPHERE
Eclipse noon: the sun held behind the black disc, a corona low in the west-south-west and a dusk band all round the
horizon. Key light from 245° at 20° (eclipse-corona); fog 140–1500 m; wind toward 70° at 4.5 m/s.
